answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 148421 Country: pakistan Title: I will recently give my final exam so please tell me any dua or wazifah so I perform better in papers and got good marks. Question: I will recently give my final exam so please tell me any dua or wazifah so I perform better in papers and got good marks. Answer ID: 148421 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 320/300/N=5/1438) Recite Ya Nasir ( يا ناصر ) 21 times after each salah, you shall have a convenient exam and will secure good marks, in-shaAllah. May you secure high marks! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
